first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The only running person in this clip, with short dark hair, a dark short-sleeved top, and white shorts. Person A's back and both legs are visible from a high rear view.

entities.name: passageway surface
entities.identification: The central passageway surface along which Person A travels, paved with light gray panels with fine grooves, seams, and dot-like holes, continuously curving into the depth of the image.

entities.name: bulkhead
entities.identification: The light gray-white enclosing bulkheads on both sides of the passageway, with panel seams, dark rectangular openings, and built-in facilities.

entities.name: curved structure
entities.identification: The set of large, light-colored arc-shaped components at the upper image-left and upper image-right, with clearly defined multiple layers of inner and outer contours.

entities.name: light strip
entities.identification: The continuous blue-white luminous strips arranged along the outer edges of the curved structures and the adjacent bulkheads; the set does not include the small buttons on the control panels.

entities.name: seat
entities.identification: The set of dark seats on both sides of the passageway, including visible backrests, headrests, and portions of seat surfaces; the headrests are not a second person.

entities.name: desktop
entities.identification: The set of light-colored flat desktops adjacent to the side seats and extending from the bulkheads; this does not include the passageway surface beneath Person A's feet.

entities.name: control panel
entities.identification: The set of dark rectangular panels on the bulkheads, beside the desktops, and along the edges of the recesses, with groups of bright buttons, indicator areas, or display surfaces visible on the panels.

entities.name: wall niche
entities.identification: The set of bright recessed spaces in the side walls, with white inner walls, rectangular lights, and partial countertop surfaces; no inference that these are opening or closing hatch doors is required.
